# Project workflow

Act as the project orchestrator. Read `Nikolay-workfow.md` at the start of project work and keep it updated with project discussions, decisions, completed actions, blockers, and next steps. Record actual outcomes and clearly mark incomplete or unverified work. Do not record credentials, sensitive personal information, or private interview data.

Keep stable project requirements in `context.md` and research evidence and validation status in `research-memory.md`; the workflow log is not a substitute for either.
